description: Run each prompt in a Pimcore 2026.3 project with and without the skill and compare the answers against the assertions.

evals.prompt: Add CKEditor to our Pimcore 2026.3 project so editors get it in Pimcore Studio instead of Quill.
evals.expected_output: Installs simply007/ckeditor-studio-bundle with Composer inside the PHP container, registers Simply007\CKEditorStudioBundle\CKEditorStudioBundle in config/bundles.php, runs assets:install and cache:clear, and keeps PimcoreQuillBundle installed.
assertions: Uses composer require simply007/ckeditor-studio-bundle
Registers Simply007\CKEditorStudioBundle\CKEditorStudioBundle in config/bundles.php
Runs bin/console assets:install and bin/console cache:clear
Does not uninstall or disable PimcoreQuillBundle
Does not suggest the ExtJS admin's CKEditor configuration or a CKEditor 4 setup

evals.prompt: We want CKEditor everywhere except the 'teaser' editable on our article page template, which should stay on Quill.
evals.expected_output: Keeps ckeditor_studio.editor at ckeditor and sets editor: 'quill' on that one editable in Twig.
assertions: Leaves the global ckeditor_studio.editor at ckeditor (or default)
Uses pimcore_wysiwyg('teaser', { editor: 'quill' }) or an equivalent per-field editor key
Mentions that PimcoreQuillBundle must stay enabled for Quill to render

evals.prompt: Turn on CKEditor AI in Pimcore Studio. Here is our trial license key: <key>.
evals.expected_output: Puts the key and the Cloud Services values into the gitignored .env.local, enables the AI gate with CKEDITOR_PREMIUM_AI=1, clears the cache, and explains that the premium code is loaded from cdn.ckeditor.com.
assertions: Stores the license key in .env.local (or another uncommitted env file), not in committed yaml
Mentions the Cloud Services variables CKEDITOR_CS_ENVIRONMENT_ID, CKEDITOR_CS_ACCESS_KEY and CKEDITOR_CS_WEBSOCKET_URL
Enables the gate through CKEDITOR_PREMIUM_AI=1 or ckeditor_studio.premium.ai.enabled
Runs cache:clear and does not ask for a frontend rebuild
Does not tell the user to npm install ckeditor5-premium-features into the project

evals.prompt: Make the hero text on our landing page editable in place, without a big toolbar frame around it.
evals.expected_output: Uses the inline editor option on the document editable: pimcore_wysiwyg(..., { editorType: 'inline' }).
assertions: Uses editorType: 'inline' on the pimcore_wysiwyg editable
Does not suggest switching the whole project to a different editor
Does not add the fullscreen button to the inline toolbar

evals.prompt: After installing the CKEditor bundle, data object fields in Studio still show the old editor. What should I check?
evals.expected_output: Checks the bundle registration, ckeditor_studio.editor and per-field editor keys, runs assets:install and cache:clear, and reloads Studio.
assertions: Checks that the bundle is registered in config/bundles.php
Checks ckeditor_studio.editor and any per-field editor key
Runs assets:install and cache:clear and reloads Studio
Does not recommend editing vendor files
